title: 5-Day Fez, Meknes & Chefchaouen Cultural Tour
metaDescription: Discover the cultural heritage of Fez and Meknes before visiting Chefchaouen on a five-day Morocco journey through medinas, monuments and the Rif region.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 5-Day Casablanca & Fez Tour traces Morocco’s history from the Atlantic coast to one of its oldest imperial cities. Start in Casablanca and continue to Rabat before reaching Meknes, then step further back in time at Volubilis, where extensive Roman remains reveal a different chapter of the country’s past. The journey finishes in Fez, with time to explore its historic medina, traditional workshops and centuries-old urban fabric.
Five days are dedicated entirely to this northern route, with private road travel between each stop. Selected hotels, breakfast and dinner as specified, local guides, airport transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Casablanca
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Airport and meet with our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Casablanca.
Hotel check-in after 14:00pm. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Casablanca

itinerary.title: Visit Rabat, Meknes and Volubilis (320km)
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Casablanca. Drive to Rabat and visit the Royal Palace of Rabat, Kasbah of the Udayas, and Hassan Tower. Continue to Meknes to visit Bab Mansour and the Jewish Quarter. Drive via Moulay Idriss Zerhoun and the Roman ruins of Volubilis before arriving in Fez. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Visiting Fez
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Fez, the spiritual capital of Morocco. Explore the Medieval Medina and visit the Bou Inania Madrasa or Attarine Medersa, Nejjarine Fountain, and the exterior of the University of al-Qarawiyyin Mosque. Optional lunch in the Medina followed by a visit to the souks and Fes el-Jdid. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Fez to Casablanca (320km)
itinerary.text: Depart from Fez and drive to Casablanca via highway. Optional lunch at a local restaurant upon arrival. Enjoy an afternoon city tour visiting the Central Market, Habous District, Royal Palace, Mohammed V Square, and the Anfa residential area. See the exterior of the Hassan II Mosque. Overnight in Casablanca.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 5-Day Morocco Travel Package?
faqs.a: The 5-Day Morocco Travel Package covers Fez, Rabat, and Casablanca. This itinerary introduces travelers to Morocco's rich history, imperial heritage, cultural landmarks, and modern city life while visiting three of the country's most important destinations. The tour runs for 4 nights and 5 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 5-Day Morocco Travel Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €950 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire journey. Comfortable vehicles are used for transfers and sightseeing, ensuring a convenient and enjoyable travel experience between destinations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels and traditional Moroccan riads with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and authentic Moroccan atmosphere.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide valuable insights into Morocco's history, culture, architecture, and local traditions throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors looking for a short but rewarding introduction to Morocco. It combines cultural experiences, historical landmarks, and urban attractions in a well-balanced itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy. Travelers should be comfortable walking through medinas, historical sites, local markets, and city centers. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Fez, Rabat, and Casablanca?
faqs.a: Fez is famous for its UNESCO-listed medieval medina, artisan workshops, and historic universities. Rabat, Morocco's capital city, offers beautiful gardens, historic monuments, and a relaxed atmosphere. Casablanca is known for the magnificent Hassan II Mosque, modern architecture, and vibrant coastal city life.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 5-Day Morocco Travel Package?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 5-Day Morocco Travel Package be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include Chefchaouen or Marrakech, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
